props.name: accept
props.description: The `accept` attribute's syntax, such as `"image/*,.pdf"`. The picker receives it as-is, and a picked file that fails it reaches `onReject` with `"type"`.

props.name: capture
props.description: Ask a phone to capture new media with the front (`"user"`) or back (`"environment"`) camera.

props.name: directory
props.description: The picker selects a folder, and `onSelect` receives its files.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the button and ignore picks.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Take more than one file. Without it, a pick in which more than one file passes `accept` rejects each of those with `"count"`. `accept` is checked first, so a file that fails it is rejected with `"type"` and never counts.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Receives the files that did not pass, each with its `reason`. For one pick it runs right after `onSelect`, in the same task.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Receives the files that passed `accept` and the count rule, in a fresh array for each pick.

props.name: size
props.description: The Button's label size: `xs`, `sm` (the default), `default` or `lg`.

props.name: variant
props.description: The fill and text colour. The theme sets the `outline` border. `link` looks like an inline text link.

props.name: withIcon
props.description: Leading icon on/off. Defaults to on: a camera with `capture`, a folder with `directory`, a paperclip otherwise. It is decorative, so the children name the button.
